svg.text: 680 Hz - 4.8 kHz (VR1 sets the High / Mid crossover point)
68 Hz - 480 Hz (VR2 sets the Mid / Low crossover point)
SUPPLY BYPASSING - one 100nF ceramic per rail, at each IC
3-Way State Variable Electronic Crossover - ESP Project 148
After Rod Elliott, Elliott Sound Products, Project 148 (https://sound-au.com/project148.htm). Redrawn for EasyEDA.
All op-amps NE5532 - 4 x DIP-8 packages. Q = 0.5 Linkwitz-Riley with R3 / R13 = 12k; use 11k2 for exact Q = 0.5, or 5k04 for Butterworth (Q = 0.707).
VR1 and VR2 are dual-gang 20k linear pots wired as rheostats. TP1 / TP2 null at the crossover frequency and may be omitted.
